title: Bog‘lovchilar: va, lekin, chunki, shuning uchun
goal_uz: Dars oxirida and, but, because va so yordamida qisqa gaplarni bog‘laysiz, sabab va natijani to‘g‘ri ifodalaysiz, vergul va so‘z tartibini xatosiz qo‘yasiz hamda 8 juft gapni bitta gapga birlashtira olasiz.

scenes.title: Bugungi dars: gaplarni bog‘lash
board: Linking words: and · but · or · because · so
Cause and result (sabab va natija)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ko‘p, oz, biroz kabi miqdor so‘zlarini o‘rgandik. Bugun gaplarni bir-biriga bog‘laymiz. Hozirgacha siz qisqa gaplar bilan gapirdingiz, bugundan boshlab esa fikringizni bog‘lab, sabab va natijani aytib, uzunroq va chiroyliroq gapira olasiz. Dars oxirida sakkiz juft gapni birlashtira olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we link short sentences with and, but, or, because and so. Your English will sound smoother and more natural.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun qisqa gaplarni and, but, or, because va so bilan bog‘laymiz. Inglizchangiz ravonroq va tabiiyroq eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Nega bog‘lovchilar kerak?
board: Short: I am tired. I go to bed.
Linked: I am tired, so I go to bed.
Linking words = connect ideas

examples.t: I am tired. I go to bed.
I am tired, so I go to bed.

scenes.say_native: Bog‘lovchi — ikki fikrni bog‘laydigan so‘z. Bog‘lovchisiz gaplar qisqa va uzuq-yuluq eshitiladi: “I am tired. I go to bed.” Bog‘lovchi bilan esa fikr o‘rtasidagi aloqa ko‘rinadi: “I am tired, so I go to bed.” Bugun to‘rtta eng muhim bog‘lovchini o‘rganamiz: and, but, because va so. Or ni ham qisqacha ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: I am tired. I go to bed. I am tired, so I go to bed.
scenes.say_uz: Charchadim. Yotaman. Charchadim, shuning uchun yotaman.

scenes.title: And: qo‘shish
board: and = va (ma’lumot qo‘shadi)
I like tea and coffee.
She opened the door and went in.

examples.t: I like tea and coffee.
She opened the door and went in.
It is cold and wet.

scenes.say_native: And — “va”. U ikkita so‘zni, iborani yoki gapni qo‘shadi. “Tea and coffee”, “cold and wet”. Ikki gapni bog‘lasa ham bo‘ladi: “She opened the door and went in.” Bu yerda ikkinchi gapda ega takrorlanmaydi, chunki ega bir xil. Uch va undan ko‘p narsa sanalganda faqat oxirgisi oldidan and: “apples, oranges and bananas”.
scenes.say: I like tea and coffee. She opened the door and went in. We bought apples, oranges and bananas.
scenes.say_uz: Men choy va qahvani yoqtiraman. U eshikni ochdi va kirdi. Biz olma, apelsin va banan sotib oldik.

scenes.title: But: qarama-qarshilik
board: but = lekin, ammo
I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
He is rich, but he isn't happy.

examples.t: I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
examples.uz: Men choyni yoqtiraman, lekin qahvani yoqtirmayman.

examples.t: The film was long, but it was good.
examples.uz: Film uzun edi, lekin yaxshi edi.

scenes.say_native: But — “lekin, ammo”. U ikki o‘zaro qarama-qarshi fikrni bog‘laydi: “The film was long, but it was good.” Bu yerda but dan oldin vergul qo‘yamiz, agar ikki to‘liq gap bog‘lanayotgan bo‘lsa. Ikki so‘zni bog‘lasa vergul shart emas: “small but comfortable”. O‘zbekcha “lekin”, “ammo”, “biroq” ning hammasi inglizchada but ga to‘g‘ri keladi.
scenes.say: I like tea, but I don't like coffee. The film was long, but it was good. The room is small but comfortable.
scenes.say_uz: Men choyni yoqtiraman, lekin qahvani yoqtirmayman. Film uzun edi, lekin yaxshi edi. Xona kichkina, lekin qulay.

scenes.title: Or: tanlov
board: or = yoki
Tea or coffee?
We can walk, or we can take a bus.

examples.t: Do you want tea or coffee?
We can walk, or we can take a bus.
examples.uz: Piyoda yurishimiz yoki avtobusga chiqishimiz mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Or — “yoki”. U tanlovni bildiradi. “Tea or coffee?” Savolda or odatda ikkinchi variantga tushadigan ohangda aytiladi. Inkor gapda ham or ishlatiladi, and emas: “I don’t like tea or coffee” — men na choyni, na qahvani yoqtiraman. Bu o‘zbekchadagi “va” bilan farqli, shuning uchun e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Do you want tea or coffee? We can walk, or we can take a bus. I don't like tea or coffee.
scenes.say_uz: Choy xohlaysizmi yoki qahva? Piyoda yurishimiz yoki avtobusga chiqishimiz mumkin. Men na choyni, na qahvani yoqtiraman.

scenes.title: And, but, or xatolari
board: ✗ I don't like tea and coffee. (na … na)
✓ I don't like tea or coffee.
✗ I like tea, and I don't like coffee.
✓ I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: inkor gapda and ishlatish. “I don’t like tea and coffee” deganda ma’no “ikkalasini birga yoqtirmayman” bo‘lib qoladi. To‘g‘risi “tea or coffee”. Ikkinchisi: qarama-qarshi fikrda and ishlatish. Agar fikrlar qarama-qarshi bo‘lsa, and emas, but kerak: “I like tea, but I don’t like coffee”.
scenes.say: I don't like tea or coffee. I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
scenes.say_uz: Men na choyni, na qahvani yoqtiraman. Choyni yoqtiraman, lekin qahvani yoqtirmayman.

scenes.title: And, but yoki or?
board: 1) I like football ___ I don't like tennis.
2) Do you want water ___ juice?
3) She is tall ___ thin.
4) It's sunny ___ cold.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Birinchi: I like football blank I don’t like tennis. Ikkinchi: Do you want water blank juice? Uchinchi: She is tall blank thin. To‘rtinchi: It’s sunny blank cold. And, but yoki or ni tanlang va gapni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I like football blank I don't like tennis. Do you want water blank juice? She is tall blank thin. It's sunny blank cold.
scenes.say_uz: Futbolni yoqtiraman, tennisni yoqtirmayman. Suv xohlaysizmi yoki sharbat? U baland va ozg‘in. Quyoshli, lekin sovuq.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) but  2) or
3) and  4) but
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “I like football, but I don’t like tennis”, qarama-qarshilik. Ikkinchi: “Do you want water or juice?”, tanlov. Uchinchi: “She is tall and thin”, bir yo‘nalishdagi ikkita xususiyat. To‘rtinchi: “It’s sunny, but cold”, quyoshli, lekin sovuq: kutilmagan farq. Agar adashgan bo‘lsangiz, o‘zingizdan so‘rang: fikrlar bir tomonlama yoki qarama-qarshimi?
scenes.say: I like football, but I don't like tennis. Do you want water or juice? She is tall and thin. It's sunny, but cold.
scenes.say_uz: Futbolni yoqtiraman, lekin tennisni yoqtirmayman. Suv xohlaysizmi yoki sharbat? U baland va ozg‘in. Quyoshli, lekin sovuq.

scenes.title: Because: sabab
board: because = chunki
Result + because + reason
I stayed at home because I was ill.

examples.t: I stayed at home because I was ill.
examples.uz: Men uyda qoldim, chunki kasal edim.

examples.t: She is happy because she passed the exam.
I like him because he is kind.
examples.uz: Men uni yoqtiraman, chunki u mehribon.

scenes.say_native: Because — “chunki”, u sababni kiritadi. Tartib: avval natija yoki holat, keyin because, keyin sabab. “I stayed at home because I was ill.” Muhim: because dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi, ya’ni ega va fe’l bor: “because I was ill”. Oldidan vergul odatda qo‘yilmaydi. Bir savolga javob sifatida because ni qisqa aytsa ham bo‘ladi: “Why? Because I was tired.”
scenes.say: I stayed at home because I was ill. She is happy because she passed the exam. Why are you late? Because I missed the bus.
scenes.say_uz: Men uyda qoldim, chunki kasal edim. U xursand, chunki imtihondan o‘tdi. Nega kechikdingiz? Chunki avtobusga ulgurmadim.

scenes.title: So: natija
board: so = shuning uchun
Reason, + so + result
I was ill, so I stayed at home.

examples.t: I was ill, so I stayed at home.
examples.uz: Kasal edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim.

examples.t: It was raining, so we took a taxi.
examples.uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi, shuning uchun taksi oldik.

scenes.say_native: So — “shuning uchun”, u natijani kiritadi. Tartib because ning teskarisi: avval sabab, keyin so, keyin natija. “I was ill, so I stayed at home.” So oldidan vergul qo‘yamiz, chunki ikki to‘liq gap bog‘lanyapti. Ikkala gap ham bir xil fikrni aytadi, faqat tartib boshqa: “I stayed at home because I was ill” va “I was ill, so I stayed at home”.
scenes.say: I was ill, so I stayed at home. It was raining, so we took a taxi. I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.
scenes.say_uz: Kasal edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim. Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi, shuning uchun taksi oldik. Qornim och edi, shuning uchun sendvich tayyorladim.

scenes.title: Because va so: ikki yo‘l
board: Result because reason.
Reason, so result.
He is tired because he worked late. = He worked late, so he is tired.

examples.t: He is tired because he worked late.
He worked late, so he is tired.
examples.uz: U kech ishladi, shuning uchun charchagan.

scenes.say_native: Bir fikrni ikki yo‘l bilan aytish mumkin. Because bilan: natija, because, sabab. So bilan: sabab, vergul, so, natija. “He is tired because he worked late.” Yoki “He worked late, so he is tired.” Qaysi birini tanlash — nimaga e’tibor qaratayotganingizga bog‘liq. Savol “Nega?” bo‘lsa, odatda because bilan javob berasiz.
scenes.say: He is tired because he worked late. He worked late, so he is tired.
scenes.say_uz: U charchagan, chunki kech ishlagan. U kech ishladi, shuning uchun charchagan.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan taqqoslash
board: Uz: chunki / shuning uchun
Eng: because / so
Uz: Kasal bo‘lgani uchun uyda qoldim.
Eng: I stayed at home because I was ill.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida sabab ko‘pincha “-gani uchun” qo‘shimchasi bilan beriladi: “Kasal bo‘lgani uchun uyda qoldim.” Fe’lning shakli o‘zgaradi. Inglizchada esa shunday qo‘shimcha yo‘q, buning o‘rniga because bilan alohida to‘liq gap tuziladi: “because I was ill”, ya’ni ega, fe’l va vaqt shakli saqlanadi. Shuning uchun inglizcha gap odatda o‘zbekchadan uzunroq bo‘ladi, bu normal.
scenes.say: I stayed at home because I was ill. In English, because needs a full sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Men uyda qoldim, chunki kasal edim. Inglizchada because dan keyin to‘liq gap kerak.

scenes.title: Because va so aralashishi
board: ✗ I was ill, because I stayed at home.
✓ I was ill, so I stayed at home.
✗ I stayed at home, so I was ill.
✓ I stayed at home because I was ill.
scenes.say_native: Eng katta xato: sabab va natijani aralashtirish. “I was ill, because I stayed at home” — bu degani “uyda qolganim uchun kasal bo‘ldim”, ma’no teskari. Qoida oddiy: because dan keyin sabab keladi, so dan keyin natija keladi. Gap yozishdan oldin o‘zingizga ayting: qaysi biri sabab, qaysi biri natija?
scenes.say: I was ill, so I stayed at home. I stayed at home because I was ill.
scenes.say_uz: Kasal edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim. Uyda qoldim, chunki kasal edim.

scenes.title: Because va to‘liq gap
board: ✗ I stayed at home because ill.
✓ I stayed at home because I was ill.
✗ Because I was ill. (gap sifatida yolg‘iz)
✓ I stayed at home because I was ill.
scenes.say_native: Yana ikkita xato. Birinchisi: because dan keyin faqat sifat yoki ot qo‘yish, “because ill”. Because dan keyin ega va fe’l bo‘lishi shart: “because I was ill”. Ikkinchisi: because li qismni alohida gap qilib yozish: “Because I was ill.” Bu to‘liq gap emas. Uni asosiy gap bilan bitta gapda qo‘shing. Faqat savolga javob sifatida yolg‘iz aytish mumkin.
scenes.say: I stayed at home because I was ill. Why? Because I was ill.
scenes.say_uz: Men uyda qoldim, chunki kasal edim. Nega? Chunki kasal edim.

scenes.title: Because yoki so?
board: 1) I was thirsty, ___ I drank some water.
2) I drank some water ___ I was thirsty.
3) She studies hard ___ she wants to pass.
4) It was late, ___ we went home.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Birinchi: I was thirsty blank I drank some water. Ikkinchi: I drank some water blank I was thirsty. Uchinchi: she studies hard blank she wants to pass. To‘rtinchi: it was late blank we went home. Because yoki so ni ayting.
scenes.say: I was thirsty blank I drank some water. I drank some water blank I was thirsty. She studies hard blank she wants to pass. It was late blank we went home.
scenes.say_uz: Chanqadim, suv ichdim. Suv ichdim, chunki chanqagan edim. U qattiq o‘qiydi, chunki o‘tishni xohlaydi. Kech bo‘ldi, uyga ketdik.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) so  2) because
3) because  4) so
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “I was thirsty, so I drank some water”, chanqash sabab, ichish natija. Ikkinchi: “I drank some water because I was thirsty”, bu yerda sabab keyin keladi. Uchinchi: “She studies hard because she wants to pass”, o‘tishni xohlashi sabab. To‘rtinchi: “It was late, so we went home”, kech bo‘lishi sabab, ketish natija. Hammasini topdingizmi? Barakalla.
scenes.say: I was thirsty, so I drank some water. I drank some water because I was thirsty. She studies hard because she wants to pass. It was late, so we went home.
scenes.say_uz: Chanqadim, shuning uchun suv ichdim. Suv ichdim, chunki chanqagan edim. U qattiq o‘qiydi, chunki o‘tishni xohlaydi. Kech bo‘ldi, shuning uchun uyga ketdik.

scenes.title: Vergul qoidasi
board: Clause 1, and / but / or / so + clause 2
I was ill, so I stayed at home.
Result because reason → no comma

examples.t: I was tired, but I finished the work.
We were late, so we ran.

scenes.say_native: Vergul haqida qoida. Ikkita to‘liq gapni and, but, or yoki so bilan bog‘laganda, bog‘lovchidan oldin vergul qo‘yiladi: “I was tired, but I finished the work.” Because oldidan esa odatda vergul qo‘yilmaydi: “I stayed at home because I was ill.” Agar ikkinchi qismda ega yo‘q bo‘lsa, vergul ham kerak emas: “She opened the door and went in.”
scenes.say: I was tired, but I finished the work. We were late, so we ran. She opened the door and went in.
scenes.say_uz: Charchagan edim, lekin ishni tugatdim. Kechikdik, shuning uchun yugurdik. U eshikni ochdi va kirdi.

scenes.title: Gap boshida because va but
board: Because + reason, + result
Because it was late, we went home.
Do not start formal writing with And / But / So

examples.t: Because it was late, we went home.

scenes.say_native: Because li qismni gap boshiga qo‘yish ham mumkin. Unda sabab qismidan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi: “Because it was late, we went home.” Bu o‘zbekcha “kech bo‘lgani uchun, uyga ketdik” tartibiga yaqin. Yozma rasmiy matnda gapni and, but yoki so bilan boshlash tavsiya etilmaydi, suhbatda esa bu tabiiy. Maktab insholarida va xatlarda gapni to‘liq yozing.
scenes.say: Because it was late, we went home. We went home because it was late.
scenes.say_uz: Kech bo‘lgani uchun uyga ketdik. Kech bo‘lgani uchun uyga ketdik.

scenes.title: Ikki gapni birlashtirish
board: 1) I'm hungry. I don't have food. → I'm hungry, but I don't have any food.
2) He studied hard. He passed. → He studied hard, so he passed.

examples.t: He studied hard, so he passed.
examples.uz: U qattiq o‘qidi, shuning uchun o‘tdi.

scenes.say_native: Endi asosiy ko‘nikma: ikkita qisqa gapni bitta gapga birlashtirish. Avval ular orasidagi aloqani aniqlang: qo‘shish, qarama-qarshilik, tanlov, sabab yoki natija. Keyin mos bog‘lovchini tanlang. “He studied hard. He passed.” — bu yerda birinchisi sabab, ikkinchisi natija, demak “He studied hard, so he passed”. Yoki teskarisi: “He passed because he studied hard”.
scenes.say: He studied hard. He passed. He studied hard, so he passed. He passed because he studied hard.
scenes.say_uz: U qattiq o‘qidi. U o‘tdi. U qattiq o‘qidi, shuning uchun o‘tdi. U o‘tdi, chunki qattiq o‘qidi.

scenes.title: Gaplarni birlashtiring
board: 1) It was cold. I wore a coat. (so)
2) I like pizza. I don't like burgers. (but)
3) She is happy. She won. (because)
4) I'll call you. I'll send a message. (or)
scenes.say_native: Har bir juftni brackets ichida ko‘rsatilgan bog‘lovchi bilan bitta gapga birlashtiring. Birinchi: it was cold, I wore a coat, so. Ikkinchi: I like pizza, I don’t like burgers, but. Uchinchi: she is happy, she won, because. To‘rtinchi: I’ll call you, I’ll send a message, or.
scenes.say: Join each pair. It was cold. I wore a coat. I like pizza. I don't like burgers. She is happy. She won. I'll call you. I'll send a message.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir juftni birlashtiring. Sovuq edi. Palto kiydim. Pitsani yoqtiraman. Burgerni yoqtirmayman. U xursand. U g‘alaba qozondi. Qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Xabar yuboraman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) It was cold, so I wore a coat.
2) I like pizza, but I don't like burgers.
3) She is happy because she won.
4) I'll call you, or I'll send a message.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “It was cold, so I wore a coat”. Ikkinchi: “I like pizza, but I don’t like burgers”. Uchinchi: “She is happy because she won”, g‘alaba — sabab. To‘rtinchi: “I’ll call you, or I’ll send a message”. Ko‘ryapsizmi, ikki to‘liq gap bo‘lganda bog‘lovchidan oldin vergul bor, because da esa yo‘q. Siz ham shunday yozdingizmi?
scenes.say: It was cold, so I wore a coat. I like pizza, but I don't like burgers. She is happy because she won. I'll call you, or I'll send a message.
scenes.say_uz: Sovuq edi, shuning uchun palto kiydim. Pitsani yoqtiraman, lekin burgerni yoqtirmayman. U xursand, chunki g‘alaba qozondi. Qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman yoki xabar yuboraman.

scenes.title: Bir gapda bir nechta bog‘lovchi
board: I was tired and hungry, so I went home.
It was late, but I wasn't tired, so I read a book.
Do not use because and so together

examples.t: It was late, but I wasn't tired, so I read a book.
examples.uz: Kech edi, lekin charchamagan edim, shuning uchun kitob o‘qidim.

scenes.say_native: Bir gapda ikki bog‘lovchi ham bo‘lishi mumkin: “It was late, but I wasn’t tired, so I read a book.” Bunda har bir bog‘lovchi o‘z vazifasini bajaradi: but qarama-qarshilik, so natija. Lekin bitta sabab-natija aloqasida because va so ni birga ishlatmang. “Because I was tired, so I went home” — o‘zbek tilidan kelgan xato, chunki o‘zbekchada “chunki” va “shuning uchun” bir gapda uchrashi mumkin.
scenes.say: I was tired and hungry, so I went home. It was late, but I wasn't tired, so I read a book.
scenes.say_uz: Men charchagan va och edim, shuning uchun uyga ketdim. Kech edi, lekin charchamagan edim, shuning uchun kitob o‘qidim.

scenes.title: Because va so bir gapda emas
board: ✗ Because I was tired, so I went home.
✓ Because I was tired, I went home.
✓ I was tired, so I went home.
scenes.say_native: Mana juda mashhur xato: because bilan so ni bir gapda ishlatish. Ikkalasi bir xil aloqani bildiradi, shuning uchun bittasini tanlang. Yo “Because I was tired, I went home”, yo “I was tired, so I went home”. O‘zbek tilida, “chunki” va “shuning uchun” ni birga aytsak ham, inglizchada bunday qilinmaydi.
scenes.say: Because I was tired, I went home. I was tired, so I went home.
scenes.say_uz: Charchaganim uchun uyga ketdim. Charchagan edim, shuning uchun uyga ketdim.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: kechikish sababi
board: A: Why are you late?
B: Because I missed the bus, so I walked.
A: But it is raining!
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki hamkasb ertalab uchrashadi. Biri kechikkan va sababini aytadi. Because, so va but qanday ishlatilganiga quloq soling. Keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Tom: Why are you late, Kate? Kate: I missed the bus, so I walked to work. Tom: But it is raining! Kate: I know, and I forgot my umbrella, so I'm wet. Tom: Take a towel, because you look cold.
scenes.say_uz: Tom: Nega kechikdingiz, Keyt? Keyt: Avtobusga ulgurmadim, shuning uchun ishga piyoda keldim. Tom: Lekin yomg‘ir yog‘yapti-ku! Keyt: Bilaman, soyabonimni ham unutdim, shuning uchun hoparman ham ho‘lman. Tom: Sochiq oling, chunki sovuq qotgandek ko‘rinasiz.

scenes.title: Dialog 1 savollari
board: 1) Why is Kate late?
2) Why does she walk?
3) Why does Tom give her a towel?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Keyt nega kechikdi? Ikkinchi: u nega piyoda keldi? Uchinchi: Tom nega unga sochiq beradi? Javobni because bilan boshlang.
scenes.say: Why is Kate late? Why does she walk? Why does Tom give her a towel?
scenes.say_uz: Keyt nega kechikdi? U nega piyoda keldi? Tom nega unga sochiq beradi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Because she missed the bus.
2) Because she missed the bus.
3) Because she looks cold.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: u kechikdi, chunki avtobusga ulgurmadi, “because she missed the bus”. Ikkinchi: u piyoda keldi, chunki avtobus ketib bo‘lgandi, ya’ni sabab o‘sha. Uchinchi: Tom unga sochiq beradi, chunki u sovuq qotgandek ko‘rinadi, “because she looks cold”. Dialogda Keyt “missed the bus, so I walked” dedi: bu yerda so natijani bildirdi.
scenes.say: She is late because she missed the bus. Tom gives her a towel because she looks cold.
scenes.say_uz: U kechikdi, chunki avtobusga ulgurmadi. Tom unga sochiq beradi, chunki u sovuq qotgandek ko‘rinadi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: dam olish kuni rejasi
board: A: Shall we go to the park or the cinema?
B: The park, because the weather is nice.
A: OK, but I'm hungry, so let's take sandwiches.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: ikki do‘st dam olish kunini rejalashtirmoqda. Or bilan tanlov, because bilan sabab va so bilan natija qanday ishlatilganiga e’tibor bering. Savollar tinglagandan keyin.
scenes.say: Ana: Shall we go to the park or to the cinema? Ben: The park, because the weather is nice. Ana: OK, but I'm hungry, so let's take some sandwiches. Ben: Good idea. I'll make them, and you can bring the drinks.
scenes.say_uz: Ana: Parkka boramizmi yoki kinoga? Ben: Parkka, chunki ob-havo yaxshi. Ana: Mayli, lekin qornim och, shuning uchun sendvich olib ketaylik. Ben: Yaxshi fikr. Men tayyorlayman, siz ichimliklarni olib keling.

scenes.title: Dialog 2 savollari
board: 1) Where do they go? Why?
2) Why do they take sandwiches?
3) Who brings the drinks?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: ular qayerga borishadi va nega? Ikkinchi: nega sendvich olishadi? Uchinchi: ichimliklarni kim olib keladi? Because yoki so bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: Where do they go, and why? Why do they take sandwiches? Who brings the drinks?
scenes.say_uz: Ular qayerga borishadi va nega? Nega sendvich olishadi? Ichimliklarni kim olib keladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The park, because the weather is nice.
2) Ana is hungry, so they take sandwiches.
3) Ana brings the drinks.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: ular parkka borishadi, chunki ob-havo yaxshi, “because the weather is nice”. Ikkinchi: Ananing qorni och, shuning uchun sendvich olishadi, “she is hungry, so they take sandwiches”. Uchinchi: Ben sendvich tayyorlaydi, ichimliklarni Ana olib keladi, “you can bring the drinks”. Dialogda uchala bog‘lovchi ham ishlatildi.
scenes.say: They go to the park because the weather is nice. Ana is hungry, so they take sandwiches. Ana brings the drinks.
scenes.say_uz: Ular parkka boradi, chunki ob-havo yaxshi. Ana och, shuning uchun sendvich olishadi. Ana ichimliklarni olib keladi.

scenes.title: Because of: qisqa shakl
board: because + subject + verb
because of + noun
We stayed in because of the rain.

examples.t: We stayed in because of the rain.
We stayed in because it was raining.

scenes.say_native: Because ning yaqin qarindoshi bor: because of. Because dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi, because of dan keyin esa faqat ot yoki ot birikmasi: “because of the rain”, “because of you”. Ikkalasi ham bir ma’noni beradi. “We stayed in because it was raining” va “We stayed in because of the rain”. Bu ikkisini aralashtirmang: “because of it was raining” xato.
scenes.say: We stayed in because it was raining. We stayed in because of the rain.
scenes.say_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgani uchun uyda qoldik. Yomg‘ir sababli uyda qoldik.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: bog‘lovchilar kuchsiz
board: and /ənd/ → “n” · but /bət/ · or /ɔː/
because /bɪˈkɒz/ · so /səʊ/
I like tea 'n' coffee.
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda and, but, or kabi bog‘lovchilar kuchsiz aytiladi. And ko‘pincha “en” yoki shunchaki “n” bo‘lib eshitiladi: tea and coffee — “tea-n-coffee”. Because da urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: “bi-KOZ”. So esa kuchli, uzun “sou”, chunki natija o‘sha yerda boshlanadi. Bu kuchsiz shakllarni eshitib o‘rgansangiz, tinglab tushunish ham yaxshilanadi.
scenes.say: Tea and coffee. I was tired, so I went home. I stayed because I was ill.
scenes.say_uz: Choy va qahva. Charchagan edim, shuning uchun uyga ketdim. Kasal bo‘lganim uchun qoldim.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
board: tea and coffee
I was tired, so I went home.
I stayed at home because I was ill.
scenes.say_native: Meni takrorlang. And ni yengil, “n” kabi ayting. Because da ikkinchi bo‘g‘inni kuchli ayting. Vergulda qisqa pauza qiling. Har bir gapni ikki marta aytib chiqing.
scenes.say: Tea and coffee. I was tired, so I went home. I stayed at home because I was ill.
scenes.say_uz: Choy va qahva. Charchagan edim, shuning uchun uyga ketdim. Kasal bo‘lganim uchun uyda qoldim.

scenes.title: Tekshiruv
board: Weak: and, but, or
Strong: because (second syllable), so
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi. Esda tuting: yengil bog‘lovchilar ritmni yaratadi, kuchli so‘zlar esa ma’noni olib yuradi. Vergul joyida qisqa pauza qiling, chunki yozuvdagi vergul nutqda pauzaga to‘g‘ri keladi. Shunda siz uzun gapni ham tushunarli va ravon ayta olasiz.
scenes.say: Short pauses help the listener.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqa pauzalar tinglovchiga yordam beradi.

scenes.title: Nutq mashqi: kunim haqida
board: Say 4 sentences about your day:
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz gapiring. Bugungi kuningiz haqida to‘rtta gap ayting. Har birida boshqa bog‘lovchi bo‘lsin: and, but, because va so. Masalan: I got up early because I had work. I was tired, so I had coffee.
scenes.say: Tell me about your day. I got up early because I had work. I was tired, so I had coffee. I wanted to walk, but it was raining.
scenes.say_uz: Kuningiz haqida ayting. Erta turdim, chunki ishim bor edi. Charchagan edim, shuning uchun qahva ichdim. Piyoda yurmoqchi edim, lekin yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I got up early because I had work.
I was tired, so I had coffee.
I wanted to walk, but it was raining.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna: “I got up early because I had work. I was tired, so I had coffee. I wanted to walk, but it was raining, so I took a bus.” Ko‘rdingizmi, sabab uchun because, natija uchun so, qarama-qarshilik uchun but. Sizning gaplaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin. Muhimi, aloqa to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin va vergullar joyida turishi.
scenes.say: I got up early because I had work. I was tired, so I had coffee. I wanted to walk, but it was raining, so I took a bus.
scenes.say_uz: Erta turdim, chunki ishim bor edi. Charchagan edim, shuning uchun qahva ichdim. Piyoda yurmoqchi edim, lekin yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi, shuning uchun avtobusga chiqdim.

scenes.title: Xatolarni to‘g‘rilang
board: 1) I was ill, because I stayed home.
2) Because I was tired, so I slept.
3) I stayed home because ill.
4) I don't like tea and coffee.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy mashq: to‘rtta gapdagi xatoni toping. Birinchi: I was ill, because I stayed home. Ikkinchi: Because I was tired, so I slept. Uchinchi: I stayed home because ill. To‘rtinchi: I don’t like tea and coffee. Har birini to‘g‘rilab ayting.
scenes.say: Correct these sentences. I was ill, because I stayed home. Because I was tired, so I slept. I stayed home because ill. I don't like tea and coffee.
scenes.say_uz: Bu gaplarni to‘g‘rilang. Kasal edim, chunki uyda qoldim. Charchagan uchun, shuning uchun uxladim. Uyda qoldim, chunki kasal. Men na choyni, na qahvani yoqtiraman.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri variantlar
board: 1) I was ill, so I stayed home.
2) I was tired, so I slept.
3) I stayed home because I was ill.
4) I don't like tea or coffee.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “I was ill, so I stayed home”, sabab va natija joyi almashgan edi. Ikkinchi: “I was tired, so I slept” yoki “Because I was tired, I slept”, ikkalasini birga ishlatmang. Uchinchi: “I stayed home because I was ill”, because dan keyin to‘liq gap. To‘rtinchi: “I don’t like tea or coffee”, inkorda or. Barcha qoidalar bitta mashqda takrorlandi.
scenes.say: I was ill, so I stayed home. I was tired, so I slept. I stayed home because I was ill. I don't like tea or coffee.
scenes.say_uz: Kasal edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim. Charchagan edim, shuning uchun uxladim. Uyda qoldim, chunki kasal edim. Men na choyni, na qahvani yoqtiraman.

scenes.title: Xulosa
board: and = qo‘shish · but = qarama-qarshilik · or = tanlov
because + sabab · so + natija
Clause, and / but / or / so + clause
because I was ill (to‘liq gap)
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. And qo‘shadi, but qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi, or tanlov beradi. Because sabab, so natija. Ikki to‘liq gapni bog‘lovchi bilan bog‘laganda oldidan vergul qo‘yamiz, because dan oldin esa odatda yo‘q. Because dan keyin to‘liq gap kerak, because va so ni bir gapda birga ishlatmang. Bularni o‘zlashtirsangiz, gapingiz ancha ravon bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: And adds, but contrasts, or gives a choice. Because gives the reason, and so gives the result. Use a comma before and, but, or and so when they join two full sentences.
scenes.say_uz: And qo‘shadi, but qarama-qarshilik beradi, or tanlov beradi. Because sababni, so natijani bildiradi. Ikki to‘liq gapni bog‘laganda bog‘lovchidan oldin vergul qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Join 8 pairs of short sentences
≥ 2 because · ≥ 2 so · ≥ 2 but
Check: comma, full sentence after because
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: sakkiz juft qisqa gapni bog‘lovchilar bilan bittadan gapga birlashtiring. Kamida ikkitasida because, ikkitasida so, ikkitasida but ishlating. Tekshiring: sabab va natija adashmagan, because dan keyin to‘liq gap bor, so dan oldin vergul bor. Keyingi darsda tabiat, hayvonlar va atrof-muhit haqida gapirishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to join eight pairs of short sentences. Next time we talk about nature, animals and the environment.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz sakkiz juft qisqa gapni birlashtirish. Keyingi darsda tabiat, hayvonlar va atrof-muhit haqida gapiramiz.

homework_uz: 8 juft qisqa gapni and, but, or, because yoki so yordamida bittadan gapga birlashtiring. Kamida 2 tasida because, 2 tasida so, 2 tasida but ishlating. Mezba: because dan keyin sabab keladi (natija emas), so dan oldin vergul bor, because dan keyin fe’l bilan to‘liq gap bor, ikkita gap bitta vergulsiz yopishtirilmagan.

quiz.q: I was tired, ___ I went to bed early.
quiz.why_uz: Natija bildirilyapti: charchadim, shuning uchun erta yotdim. Natija oldidan so ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: I went to bed early ___ I was tired.
quiz.why_uz: Sabab bildirilyapti: erta yotdim, chunki charchagan edim. Because sabab oldidan keladi.

options: I like tea but I don't like coffee.
I like tea because I don't like coffee.
I like tea so I don't like coffee.
I like tea or I don't like coffee.
quiz.why_uz: Qarama-qarshilik bor: choyni yoqtiraman, lekin qahvani yoqtirmayman. Bu yerda but.

options: Because I was ill. I stayed at home.
I stayed at home because I was ill.
I stayed at home because of I was ill.
I stayed at home because ill.
quiz.why_uz: Because dan keyin to‘liq gap (ega + fe’l) keladi. Yolg‘iz because bilan gap tugamaydi.
Tanlov bor: choy yoki qahva. Tanlovda or ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: It was raining, ___ we stayed inside.
quiz.why_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘di, shuning uchun uyda qoldik. Natijani so bildiradi.

options: She is happy, because she passed the exam.
She is happy because she passed the exam.
She is happy because passed the exam.
She is happy so she passed the exam.
quiz.why_uz: Because oldidan odatda vergul qo‘yilmaydi, va keyin ega ham aytiladi: because she passed.

quiz.q: I like him, ___ he is very kind.
quiz.why_uz: Sabab: unga yoqaman, chunki u juda mehribon. Because.

quiz.q: He is rich ___ he isn't happy.
quiz.why_uz: Kutilmagan, qarama-qarshi fikr: boy, lekin baxtli emas. But.

options: I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.
I was hungry, because I made a sandwich.
I was hungry, but I made a sandwich.
I was hungry or I made a sandwich.
quiz.why_uz: Ochlik sabab, sendvich tayyorlash natija. Natija uchun so, uning oldidan vergul.
